name: Textured Vegetable Protein (TVP)
siboNotes: TVP is well-tolerated by most SIBO patients as it's low FODMAP and highly processed soy protein. The fiber content is moderate and generally digestible.
preparationTips: Rehydrate with low-FODMAP broth or water before cooking
Season with garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Add herbs like oregano, basil, or thyme for flavor
Can be used as ground meat substitute in sauces and stews
pairsWellWith: Low-FODMAP vegetables like carrots and bell peppers
nutritionalHighlights: High complete protein (about 12g per 1/2 cup serving)
Good source of iron and B vitamins
